summary: Reconcile completion of the immutable T5 Click raw first run and its semantic Case-C evaluation, close the stale raw-run cursor, and leave successor trial selection explicitly un-derived without changing Skill or framework semantics.

requirements.rationale: T5 is evaluation evidence under the existing #46 protocol and does not alter Requirement semantics.

issues_findings.rationale: T5 raw evidence is durably preserved and the semantic evaluation records conforming Case-C discrimination with provenance-limited verification of external source execution. #46 remains open for the trial programme.

risks.rationale: Authority laundering, solutionism, false assurance, self-reinforcing interpretation and execution/progress burden remain relevant. The evaluation explicitly separates semantic conformance from unverified external source-call provenance and creates no downstream authority.

decisions_concepts.rationale: No Skill revision, Generic-Fit claim, framework semantic, Authority, Requirement or Building Block is promoted by the T5 result.

derived_views.rationale: CURRENT_STATE is refreshed only to bind the derived view to the T5 evaluation-closure reconciliation; it remains non-canonical.

planning_execution_cursor.rationale: The T5 raw-run and semantic-evaluation gates are complete, so the raw-first-run next action is removed. #46 remains focus, implementation stays disabled, and no T6/Case-D successor is selected by this closure.

active_work.rationale: #46 remains the active programme owner with T5 completed. Case D remains required by the programme but unselected/unfrozen by this closure; R3, Generic Fit and PR #51 merge remain unselected/unpromoted.
